The '''EchoBurst concussion missile''' was a model of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] manufactured by [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek Incorporated]]. The [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] were equipped with advanced [[homing computer]]s.<ref name="EGWT" />
